title: Nightfall: WoW meets Tarkov in a holy city that died at its own festival. Does the game concept land?
author: zanemoore575
selftext:
Hey everyone! I'm a dad of 3 boys (Yeah the boys!) in New Zealand and in my spare time I’ve been learning to build a game in Godot! I have used Claude Code to help me learn to use the game engine, to understand how to create animations and VFX, stage movies and scenes, and I’ve learnt that creating something actually good and fun takes a really long time. The 80% is easy, it’s that last 20% that seems to take the longest.  
Now that I have a small version playable, I’m really keen to have people try it and share their thoughts on the game, whether the concept lands, and honestly just share any tips on how I can make the game better and more interesting to others :)

The idea is WoW meets Tarkov. It plays like a classic MMO, with tab targeting, auto attacks, a hotbar and slow, deliberate fights. But you're on a raid, and anything you take in or find in there is gone if you die before you get out.

Free to play here: [https://middafrostey.itch.io/nightfall](https://middafrostey.itch.io/nightfall)

**How a raid goes**

You take a job at the camp outside Dawnhold, the games main menu/hub. You go in with a lantern, search what's left, pick your fights and try to make it back out.  
A bell rings as the night goes on. On the fourth bell, 12 minutes in, the dead get up, including the ones you've already killed. Your lantern weakens them, but from then on it's also how they find you. On the sixth bell, at 22 minutes, the dark takes anyone still inside.

**What's in the demo and what isn't**  
It's one small corner of the city and it's still rough. You can play a Paladin or a Mage. It's solo and PvE only right now, so the Tarkov part is the risk and the extraction. Other players and PvP are planned, but they aren't in this build.

Comments here, the itch page or the Discord all work: [https://discord.gg/EN933HVEb](https://discord.gg/EN933HVEb)

It's about 400 MB, for Windows or a Mac with an M1 or newer. It isn't signed yet, so your computer will warn you, and the page says what to click. The first launch can sit on a dark screen for a minute.
